verdict.rationale: Configurable cloud environments are a fair axis for an agentic coding platform, but the evidence does not describe one. Nothing shows a hosted or cloud workspace where a developer declares repository dependencies and setup steps. The closest items are local: a CLI sandbox that controls mounted files, Git worktrees for isolated folders, hooks that run shell commands during the agent loop, and remote control of desktop sessions on your own machines. None of these is a reproducible cloud environment definition.
